claims.text: A 60-second apnea event was detected in recording c03 starting at 2000-01-06T06:45:00+00:00 and ending at 2000-01-06T06:46:00+00:00, corresponding to window index 405.
The detector flagged this window as an anomaly with a reconstruction error of 0.3557, exceeding the anomaly threshold of 0.2722; the normalized margin was 0.3066, and the anomaly margin was 0.0835.
The detector is a BiLSTM temporal-attention autoencoder (model version apnea-06-c03_seed2026) trained on the apnea dataset, with test patient c03 and fold ID apnea-06-c03.
No signal-level summary or attention-based explanation was available for this window; attention semantics indicate shared window-level temporal relevance, not channel-specific importance.
The current event is supported by detector evidence showing the reconstruction error exceeded the threshold, but no signal or attention evidence was available to further characterize the anomaly.
